title: Runoff and watersheds
summary: Surface water flows downhill into streams and rivers; a watershed is all land draining to one outlet.

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body: Runoff and watersheds. Surface water flows downhill into streams and rivers; a watershed is all land draining to one outlet.

sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Runoff gathers into rills, streams, and rivers that carry water — and sediment — to lakes and seas. Every point on land belongs to a watershed; what happens upstream shapes everything downstream.

In depth.
